notes.text: Staff key is now 0000, typed on the number keyboard.
Fixed: turning on notifications on iPhone now really registers your phone. The staff key box accepts small letters, spaces and long dashes.

Real phone notifications: turn them on in Me, and the club can send you deals even when the app is closed. Deals are now the same on every phone. Staff mode uses a staff key and can send a notification to all players.
Fixed the app icon: the phone now gets the new Cyber Colizeum logo icon (re-add the app to the Home Screen once).
The club's real logo: new app icon, the CYBER COLIZEUM name at the top of Live, and the logo on the Me screen.
First real version: live map of all 48 PCs, deals with codes, booking, messages, and Staff mode to make deals and confirm bookings (demo data).
First version: the app shell (four tabs, install guide, updates, offline).
